FLASHSCORE PREVIEW

Aberdeen face Dundee FC at Pittodrie Stadium in round 15 of the Premiership. The odds bookmakers offered on this match give Aberdeen a 50% win probability, compared with 25% for Dundee FC.

Current Form - Aberdeen

Aberdeen are eighth on 14 points after 14 matches, with a record of four wins, two draws and eight losses and a goal record of 18-23. Their last league match was a 2-3 loss away to Rangers, while their last five matches brought one win and four losses. Across that recent window, Aberdeen scored 1.6 goals per match compared with 1.3 for the season, while conceding 2.6 against a season figure of 1.6. Their expected goals stand at 1.28 against a league average of 1.66, and their expected goals conceded at 1.76 against 1.65.

Current Form - Dundee FC

Dundee FC sit seventh on 17 points from 14 matches, with five wins, two draws and seven losses and a goal record of 19-25. Their last league match ended in a 1-2 loss away to Hibernian, and they have lost their last three matches. Dundee FC recorded one win and four losses in their last five matches; their scoring average in that period was 1.2, down from 1.4 across the season, while their conceding average rose to 3.0 from 1.8. Their expected goals are 1.33 against a league average of 1.66, with expected goals conceded at 1.82 against 1.65.

Head-to-Head Record

The average goals figure across the last five meetings is 4.0. Aberdeen have won two and lost three of their last five meetings against Dundee FC. Dundee FC have won their last three meetings against Aberdeen, every one of them since February 2026. Earlier this season, Dundee FC beat Aberdeen 2-0 at home.

Aberdeen vs Dundee FC

Key Players to Watch and Missing Players

For Aberdeen, forward Kevin Nisbet has scored six goals and provided three assists. Midfielder Findlay Marshall has made nine appearances, scoring two goals and supplying one assist, while midfielder Brad Lyons has made eight appearances and scored three goals, including two in his last five matches. Chris Cadden is a doubt, while Lewis Mayo and Mats Knoester are unavailable. Connor Ronan, who has two goals and two assists this season, is also a doubt.

Dundee FC's Ryan Astley has provided two assists, while defender Joe Wright has made four appearances and scored one goal. Midfielder Alan Forrest has made 13 appearances and supplied two assists. Jack Moorhouse is unavailable.

ℹ️ Interceptions: 10.7 per match (league average 8.6)

Match Notes

Owen Bevan has received one red card in Dundee FC's last 10 matches, with that card coming two matches ago. Tony Yogane is now at Aberdeen after arriving directly from Dundee FC, where he made 36 appearances and scored one goal across one season.
